verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents a REST API with OAuth and personal-access-token auth, plus webhooks and an embed library, so programmatic access exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matching the UI's breadth: workflows, meeting polls, Stripe payments, round robin and team links, branding and limits are documented only as UI features. Webhook setup itself is described as a UI step (Settings > Integrations), and no public OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: an endpoint inventory showing API coverage of UI features (links, workflows, polls, payments, team or round-robin configuration, settings), API-driven webhook management, a published machine-readable API spec, and independent confirmation of parity.
